authority_declaration_floor_reason: A stale index is wrong in the direction that matters: it reports a newly-landed declaration as still absent, so an expired claim reads as still-valid. Measured 2026-08-27, the COMMITTED snapshot artifacts/autogenesis/kernel-dependency-projection-v1.json held 1,644 declarations against a live 1,861 -- a 217-declaration gap. This floor is deliberately BELOW the live count and above that gap: it must reject a snapshot that stale without redding every lane whose branch predates today's landings by a handful of declarations. Raise it when the gap it needs to catch grows; lower it only if declarations were genuinely removed.
bare_named_claim_budget_reason: Lowered 2026-08-31 (absence-matcher lane) from 249 to 122 by NARROWING the matcher, not by annotating and not by --update-budget. The 249 was tracking NOISE: a claim phrase fired on one sentence of a multi-paragraph block and DECL_RE then harvested every `Root.name` in the WHOLE block as that claim's subject -- most cited as PRESENT evidence in a neighbouring sentence. Two independent hand audits reached the same verdict (2026-08-27: 55 of 70 rejected as not genuine; 2026-08-31: every one of the remaining 249 rejected, across all 66 single-candidate blocks, every docs/research/09-decisions/ site and every line-paired candidate), and the second recommended this fix and scoped itself out of it. A claim is now paired with the names in its OWN unit -- a Markdown table row or list item, then a sentence within it -- while the BLOCK remains the unit a marker attaches to, and a marker only silences a claim whose subject it actually NAMES. Measured on the real tree against a fresh kernel_declaration_projection: 250 bare -> 122, and the worst single site fell from 93 harvested candidates (one Markdown table) to 8. Verified NOT a weakening: all 11 declarations across the 8 genuinely-stale claims the 2026-08-31 absence-and-orphans lane corrected are still attributed to their claim by the narrowed matcher, pinned as a regression suite in scripts/tests/fixtures/absence-stale-claims/ and driven by StaleClaimRegression in scripts/tests/test_check_absence_claims.py. ADR-1190. Lower this budget further by annotating a claim (preferred); raising it needs the same kind of measurement this reason records.

excluded_paths.reason: Generated by scripts/gen-plan.py and never hand-edited (CLAUDE.md Session Protocol), so a marker written here is erased by the next regeneration. Its absence claims come from docs/plan/status/*.md and docs/plan/global/*.md, which ARE scanned -- annotate them at the source.
